concurrent_writes: impossible by construction: only the parent opens the checkpoint path, once per completed task, via atomic tmp+replace
corruption_on_interrupt: tmp file unlinked on failure; os.replace is atomic; partial resume file never parsed as complete (entries keyed by exact identity+stamp)
resume: identity (race_id, frame_index) + config stamp (executor_version, arm, seed, count, rho) must both match; stale entries ignored and recomputed; corrupt file falls back to recompute, never blocks
stale_protection: bump EXECUTOR_VERSION or change any config field and old entries are ignored (verified by _stamp_matches unit test)
